title: What broke running agents on free-tier quotas
hook: I treated every 429 the same and it cost me a day
subtitle: Lessons learned from building a personal multi-agent AI assistant

slides.heading: The swarm ate my whole quota
slides.body: 70,000 tokens triggered rate limits almost immediately

slides.heading: Not all 429s are equal
slides.body: Per-minute limit: back off and retry, per-day limit: do not retry
slides.code:
if 429 == TPM: retry
elif 429 == TPD: do not retry

slides.heading: A colon broke the build
slides.body: Unquoted colons in YAML frontmatter caused errors

slides.heading: Latency was 8x over budget
slides.body: Median response time: 6.7 seconds, p90: 24.0 seconds

slides.heading: Model fallback across providers
slides.body: Chain consists of 4 models from different providers

slides.heading: One model could not call tools
slides.body: gpt-oss-20b produced output_parse_failed and tool_use_failed errors

slides.heading: Two repos, one mistake
slides.body: Automation stopped one step short of being useful

outro: Save this for later and swipe back to slide 1
caption:
Building a personal multi-agent AI assistant on free-tier quotas? I learned some hard lessons. 
Here are the top takeaways. 
Don't make the same mistakes I did!
